files.name: query.sql

prompt.vi: Thêm khách hàng mới: id 9, name 'Khanh Ly', city 'Hue' (email và joined_date có thể để trống). Sau đó SELECT count(*) từ customers.
prompt.en: Add a new customer: id 9, name 'Khanh Ly', city 'Hue' (email and joined_date may be left empty). Then SELECT count(*) from customers.

hint.vi: INSERT INTO customers (id, name, city) VALUES (9, 'Khanh Ly', 'Hue');
hint.en: INSERT INTO customers (id, name, city) VALUES (9, 'Khanh Ly', 'Hue');

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
INSERT INTO customers (id, name, city) VALUES (9, 'Khanh Ly', 'Hue');
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

checks.test: q("SELECT city FROM customers WHERE name='Khanh Ly'").length===1&&q("SELECT city FROM customers WHERE name='Khanh Ly'")[0][0]==='Hue'

prompt.vi: Hai việc: (1) tăng giá 10% cho mọi sản phẩm nhóm 'Furniture'; (2) xoá các sản phẩm đã hết hàng (stock = 0).
prompt.en: Two jobs: (1) raise prices by 10% for every 'Furniture' product; (2) delete products that are out of stock (stock = 0).

hint.vi: UPDATE products SET price = price * 1.1 WHERE category = 'Furniture'; DELETE FROM products WHERE stock = 0;
hint.en: UPDATE products SET price = price * 1.1 WHERE category = 'Furniture'; DELETE FROM products WHERE stock = 0;
